record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare AERIAL_ACE: Yanma (1 star, range 2, passive CLEAR_WING), Ninjask (2 stars, range 1, no passive) and Yanmega (2 stars, range 2, passive CLEAR_WING). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), range and maxPP. The CLEAR_WING passive is not covered.
record.summary: The caster deals TRUE damage (raw 25/50/100/200 by stars) to the cast target. Nothing else: no movement, status or buff in the strategy.

targeting.note: Single target; the base default requiresTarget = true means the caster must reach its target before casting.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); if the cast crit, x critPower, where Rocky Helmet and Black Augurite crit reductions do not apply to TRUE damage.
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: TRUE damage is not divided by DEF/SPE_DEF and skips the flat damage reductions (the SPE_DEF division in the neighbouring SPECIAL branch does not apply), at least 1 damage; shield absorbs before HP; protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target block the hit entirely. takenDamage includes shield damage.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the units here are 1 or 2 stars at their bare factory values, so only 25 and 50 apply; the 3- and 4-star values (100, 200) are not used by them. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond having a cast target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; every cast is independent.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 25 (1 star) / 50 (2 stars). Requested = raw; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor if the cast crit); the TRUE branch skips the SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; takenDamage (as reported by handleDamage) includes shield damage. None is computed here for a specific target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, resurrection, field multipliers); only the TRUE branch of the DEF/SPE_DEF step and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
unresolved: Whether TRUE damage skips every item-based or effect-based reduction in handleDamage: only the branch around the flat reductions was read
Whether the passive CLEAR_WING changes anything about this cast (not investigated)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
